full_prompt_en: A square blue-hour photograph depicts a large irregular complex clad in rippling gray metal. The structure fills most of the frame and rises in several connected towers of uneven height. Its central face bends in a soft wave near the roof, while adjoining volumes tilt and fold into asymmetric angles. Narrow horizontal courses in the metal skin catch the fading cool sky light, tracing each warped surface. Many rectangular windows of slightly different size and placement glow amber from within, scattered across the upper stories like warm notes in the steel-blue mass. At ground level, tall glass entrance walls reveal a bright lobby; their vertical mullions create a clear rhythm beneath the contorted upper forms. A deep projection at right shelters an illuminated glazed corner and stands on a pale concrete support. The foreground is a broad empty paved plaza, its large stone slabs and faint warm reflections leading toward the entrance. Low darker neighboring buildings sit far left and at the right horizon, dwarfed by the central structure. The camera faces the complex from a slightly low, wide viewpoint, allowing the whole silhouette to lean against a clouded blue-gray evening sky. Cool ambient light remains on the metallic cladding, while warm interior light defines the windows, doors, and pavement highlights. The image is crisp and realistic, revealing tiny metal seams, irregular window openings, and the exact curves of the facade. The overall composition balances energetic warped geometry with a calm open foreground and a coherent cool-warm light contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形蓝色时刻照片描绘一座覆以波纹灰色金属的大型不规则建筑群。建筑占据画面大部分，由几座高度不同、相互连通的塔体升起。中央表面在屋顶附近柔和弯曲成波浪，邻接体量则倾斜、折叠为不对称角度。金属表皮上的狭窄水平纹路接住渐暗天空的冷光，描出每一片扭曲表面。许多大小和位置略有差异的矩形窗从内部透出琥珀色亮光，散布在上层，如钢蓝体量中的温暖音符。地面层高耸玻璃入口墙显出明亮大厅；竖向窗框在弯折的上部形体下形成清楚节奏。右侧一块深深突出的体量遮住明亮的玻璃转角，由浅色混凝土支撑。前景是宽阔空荡的铺石广场，大片石板和微弱暖色反光把视线引向入口。更低更暗的邻近建筑位于远处左侧与右端地平线，被中央建筑衬得很小。相机以略低的宽视角面对建筑，让完整轮廓倚在多云蓝灰暮色天空前。冷色环境光仍留在金属覆面上，温暖室内光则界定窗、门和铺面高光。图像清晰写实，呈现金属细缝、不规则窗洞与立面精确曲线。整体构图用宁静空旷的前景与连贯冷暖光对照，平衡充满动势的扭曲几何。
style_prompt_en: The blue-hour photographic style contrasts cool metallic surfaces with warm light glowing through small rectangular apertures. Broad planes bend, ripple, and fold into an irregular silhouette, while fine horizontal seams reveal the direction of each curve. Steel blue, slate gray, and clouded cyan dominate the exterior values; amber and honey light provide concentrated points of warmth. Soft dusk illumination preserves detail on the reflective skin without harsh midday shadows. Glassy lower planes add clean vertical lines beneath more fluid upper contours. A wide low viewpoint gives the forms scale, and an open foreground allows the layered silhouette to breathe. Subtle reflections on paving or other flat surfaces extend the warm accents without overcrowding the scene. Crisp realistic detail keeps warped geometry physically convincing. The whole image feels dynamic yet composed, with an expressive outline held together by disciplined cool-warm contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 这种蓝色时刻摄影风格让冷调金属表面与从小型矩形孔洞透出的暖光对照。大片平面弯曲、起伏和折叠为不规则轮廓，细密水平接缝则指明每一道曲面的方向。钢蓝、石板灰和多云青蓝主导外部明度，琥珀与蜜色光形成集中的暖点。柔和暮光保留反射表皮的细节，而没有正午的生硬阴影。下部光洁平面在更流动的上部轮廓下加入干净竖线。宽阔低视点赋予形体尺度，敞开前景让分层轮廓拥有呼吸空间。铺面或其他平坦表面的细微倒影延续暖色点缀，却不使画面拥挤。清晰的写实细节让扭曲几何显得真实可信。整幅图富有动感却保持秩序，以克制的冷暖对照统合表现力强的外轮廓。
theme_en: A rippling metal-clad complex glowing at blue hour
theme_zh: 蓝色时刻中发光的波纹金属建筑群
name: Frank Gehry
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
